greeting.question: Where would you like to be by tonight?

speak: Ask me anything about the journey. I answer from a short script for now; a person reads every request.

fallback.text: That one is for a person at the desk. Shall I start a request for you?

intents.text: Sunset in Alpina is at {sunset} today. Leave Geneva by {leaveBy} and you land with light to spare.
intents.textNoData: Tell me your date and the desk will time the landing before sunset.

intents.text: Skis travel with you, tagged to the chalet. You see them again in the boot room.
From the apron at Alpina a twin-engine helicopter takes you up to Valtor in about twelve minutes, when the weather allows.
Right now in Alpina: {weather}. The mountain team checks again an hour before you land.
intents.textNoData: I can't reach the weather service at the moment. The mountain team checks it an hour before you land.

intents.text: Every journey is quoted for your group. Tell me the date and the number of guests and the desk sends a figure.
Dogs are welcome in the cabin and the car. Tell the desk their size so we choose the right vehicle.
In the sample journey, Geneva to the chalet door takes eighty-one minutes.
The car stops at your door. The heating has been on since the afternoon and the fire is lit as you leave the pad.
Your group travels alone at every stage. Names and times stay with the desk.
I'm {name}, an AI concierge. I can show you how a journey works. Requests always go to a person at the desk.
The sample journey leaves from Geneva. The desk plans from any airport that can take a private jet.
Hello. Ask me about the route, the weather in Alpina, or how the desk plans a journey.
